app.name: Werewolf Online
app.tagline: Run a live Werewolf game. Scan a QR code, get your role, vote on your phone.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Each night the pack agrees on one victim to devour. By day, pretend to be an innocent villager.
werewolf.tips:
During the day talk like a villager: ask questions, suspect others, and don't stay quiet too long.
Bite the Seer, Witch, Bodyguard or whoever is reasoning best.
Don't defend packmates too openly. Sometimes vote with the village to keep your cover.

villager.name: Villager
villager.desc: No special power. Use reasoning and intuition to find the Werewolves.
villager.tips:
Watch who keeps changing their mind, who defends whom, and who jumps on the bandwagon at the last second.
Share your reasoning: silent players get suspected and hanged by mistake.
You have nothing to lose, so you can bluff a strong role to draw the wolves away from the real Seer.

seer.name: Seer
seer.desc: Each night, inspect one player to learn whether they are a Werewolf.
seer.tips:
Don't reveal yourself too early: the wolves will bite you that same night.
Remember every result. Once you've found a wolf, or you're about to die, reveal everything.
Check the loud, influential players first: that's where wolves like to hide.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Each night, protect one player from the Werewolves. You can’t protect the same person two nights in a row.
bodyguard.tips:
Guess who the wolves want most: usually whoever just revealed a strong role or argued well.
You can't protect the same person two nights in a row, so plan a night ahead.
Keep your role secret: if the wolves know you're the Bodyguard, they'll bite you first.

witch.name: Witch
witch.desc: You have one healing potion and one poison, each usable once. You learn who the Werewolves attacked.
witch.tips:
The healing potion is worth most on a key role. Don't rush it on night one if unsure.
Only poison when you're fairly sure who's a wolf. Poisoning a villager costs the village a life.
Knowing who was bitten is a big clue: wolves often bite whoever suspected them.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.desc: When you die, you take one other player down with you.
hunter.tips:
Keep track of your top suspect all game: that's who you take with you when you die.
Revealing you're the Hunter can make wolves hesitant to bite or hang you.
Don't shoot in a hurry: think about who pushed you onto the block.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.desc: On the first night, link two players as lovers. If one dies, the other dies of heartbreak.
cupid.action: Choose two players to fall in love
cupid.tips:
Pairing two from the same side is safe. Mixing sides creates a couple that wins only by surviving together.
Pairing yourself gives you one ally you can always trust.
After night one you're a villager: keep helping the village find wolves.

cursedWolf.name: Cursed Wolf
cursedWolf.desc: Bites with the pack every night. Once per game, may curse the victim: if nobody saves them, they don't die but turn into a werewolf.
cursedWolf.tips:
Curse a strong role (Seer, Bodyguard...) to turn them into a packmate instead of killing them.
A night with no death looks like a save by the Bodyguard or Witch, which hides the curse.
You only get one curse, so save it for when it matters most.

wolfSeer.name: Wolf Seer
wolfSeer.desc: Bites with the pack every night. Each night also inspects one player to learn their exact role.
wolfSeer.tips:
Check players to find the Seer, Witch or Bodyguard, then point the pack at them.
You learn real roles: you can pose as the Seer by day with half-true information.
Don't let the village see you know too much, or you'll be suspected at once.

elder.name: Elder
elder.desc: Has two lives against the wolves: survives the first bite. Poison and the gallows still kill.
elder.tips:
You survive the first bite, so you can speak up boldly.
You can bluff a strong role as a decoy: the first bite won’t kill you.
Beware of hanging and poison: those still kill you outright.

idiot.name: Village Idiot
idiot.desc: If the village votes to hang you, you reveal your card and live, but you can never vote again.
idiot.tips:
Being hanged won't kill you, so you can accuse people boldly.
After you're revealed you lose your vote, but you can still talk: lead the village with words.
Getting you hanged wastes a village day, so don't draw suspicion on purpose.

lycan.name: Lycan
lycan.desc: Has wolf blood: the Seer sees you as a Werewolf, but you still win with the village.
lycan.tips:
The Seer sees you as a wolf. If accused, calmly defend yourself with what you've done.
Consider claiming Lycan early if the Seer seems to be checking around you.
You're still a villager: focus on finding wolves like everyone else.

sister.name: Sister
sister.desc: Two sisters who know each other from the start. Trust each other and find the wolves.
sister.tips:
Sisters know each other are villagers: the most trustworthy pair in town.
You can reveal together to vouch for each other, but the wolves will target you.
Voting together can steer the whole village.

wildChild.name: Wild Child
wildChild.desc: On the first night, pick a role model. While they live you are a villager. If they die, you turn into a werewolf.
wildChild.tips:
Pick a role model you think will live long, so you stay a villager as long as possible.
If your role model dies you become a wolf: switch play style and hide the change.
Defending your role model by day is a way of protecting yourself.

medium.name: Medium
medium.desc: Each night (once someone has died), contact one dead player to learn their exact role.
medium.action: Pick a dead player to contact
medium.tips:
Contact the dead player the village is still arguing about: their real role confirms or exposes claims.
If a self-declared Seer died, contact them to see if they told the truth.
Keep your role quiet until you have something worth revealing.

mayor.name: Mayor
mayor.desc: Your vote counts twice, in the nomination and in the verdict.
mayor.tips:
Your vote counts double, so it often decides who hangs. Vote carefully.
Revealing you're the Mayor helps you lead but makes you a wolf target.
Wolves may try to sway you: watch who keeps pushing you to vote their way.

bigBadWolf.name: Big Bad Wolf
bigBadWolf.desc: Bites with the pack, then bites a second victim every night. Loses that power as soon as a wolf dies.
bigBadWolf.tips:
You bite an extra person each night, so aim straight at the village's key roles.
You lose the extra bite once a wolf dies, so quietly protect your packmates by day.
Two deaths in one night panics the village: use it to spread suspicion.

minion.name: Minion
minion.desc: A human who wins with the wolves. You know who the wolves are; they don't know you. The Seer sees you as a villager.
minion.tips:
You know the wolves but they don't know you. Quietly steer votes away from the pack.
The Seer sees you as a villager: you can fake being the Seer to cause chaos.
Getting hanged instead of a wolf is still a way to help your team win.

knight.name: Rusty Knight
knight.desc: If the wolves bite you to death, your rusty sword kills one of them the following night.
knight.tips:
A wolf dies the night after they bite you, so revealing may scare them off.
Or stay hidden and let the wolves bite you by mistake.
If you die from a bite, whoever dies from the rusty sword next night is surely a wolf.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.desc: Bites with the pack. Each night picks someone who can't chat, use the mic or vote the next day.
silencer.tips:
Silence whoever is reasoning well or suspecting the pack.
Silenced players can't vote either: use it when a packmate is close to being hanged.
Don't keep silencing the same kind of player, or the village will see who you fear.

tanner.name: Tanner
tanner.desc: You just want to hang: if the village votes to hang you, you win alone.
tanner.tips:
You want to be hanged, but don't be obvious: the village will catch on and spare you.
Act slightly suspicious: give inconsistent answers, defend suspects.
If the wolves kill you, you lose, so don't look like a threat to them.

whiteWolf.name: White Wolf
whiteWolf.desc: Bites with the pack, and every other night may kill one of the wolves. Wins only as the last one standing.
whiteWolf.action: Pick a wolf to kill (or pass)
whiteWolf.tips:
Play like a normal wolf at first so the pack trusts you.
On even nights you can kill a wolf: do it while many are alive so no one guesses.
You only win as the last one standing, so let villagers and wolves wear each other down.

serialKiller.name: Serial Killer
serialKiller.desc: Kills one player every night and survives the wolves' bite. Wins only as the last one standing.
serialKiller.tips:
Wolf bites can't kill you, so you only need to avoid hanging.
Kill whoever is most dangerous to you: the Seer and anyone suspecting you.
By day pose as a villager and blame the wolves for your kills.

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.desc: Each night douses one house in oil, or sets every doused house alight. Wins only as the last one standing.
arsonist.tips:
Douse many houses quietly, then ignite once to burn them all.
Nobody dies on dousing nights, so you're hard to spot.
Ignite before you're suspected: one well-timed fire can sweep the village.

script.title: Narration
script.lobby: Welcome, villagers! Scan the QR code on the screen and enter your name to join.
script.roleReveal: Press and hold the card on your phone to see your role. Don’t let anyone peek! When everyone is ready, the first night begins.
script.nightStart: Night {n} falls. Everyone, close your eyes…

step.cupid: Cupid, wake up. Choose two players to fall in love… Cupid, go back to sleep.
step.bodyguard: Bodyguard, wake up. Who will you protect tonight?… Bodyguard, go back to sleep.
step.werewolf: Werewolves, wake up and recognise each other. Who will you devour tonight?… Werewolves, go back to sleep.
step.witch: Witch, wake up. This is tonight’s victim. Will you use your healing potion? Will you use your poison on anyone?… Witch, go back to sleep.
step.seer: Seer, wake up. Whose identity will you reveal tonight?… Seer, go back to sleep.
step.wolfSeer: Wolf Seer, open your eyes. Whose role do you want to see tonight?… Wolf Seer, go back to sleep.
step.cursedWolf: Cursed Wolf, open your eyes. This is the pack's victim. Do you want to curse them into a werewolf?… Cursed Wolf, go back to sleep.
step.wildChild: Wild Child, wake up. Choose someone to be your role model… Wild Child, go back to sleep.
step.medium: Medium, wake up. Which of the dead do you want to contact?… Medium, go back to sleep.
step.bigBadWolf: Big Bad Wolf, open your eyes. Who else do you want to bite?… Big Bad Wolf, go back to sleep.
step.silencer: Silencer, open your eyes. Who do you want to silence tomorrow?… Silencer, go back to sleep.
step.whiteWolf: White Wolf, open your eyes. Do you want to kill one of the wolves tonight?… White Wolf, go back to sleep.
step.serialKiller: Serial Killer, wake up. Who do you want to kill tonight?… Serial Killer, go back to sleep.
step.arsonist: Arsonist, wake up. Whose house do you douse, or do you strike the match tonight?… Arsonist, go back to sleep.

script.stepNobody: (This role is dead or absent — still read the line and pause a few seconds so nothing is given away.)

script.hunterMissed: The Hunter lowers the gun and shoots no one.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Werewolf Online is a free web app for running live Werewolf games. This page explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.p1: Without signing in: your display name, emoji, the name style and frame you pick, and game data (roles, votes). Guest profiles are only stored in your browser.
privacy.p2: With Google sign-in: we only receive your Google account identifier, your name and your public profile photo. We never receive your password and never read your email, contacts or any other Google data.
privacy.p3: Profile photos you upload are resized and stored on our server so they can be shown in games.
privacy.p4: Your data is only used to show your name, photo and profile to the players in your room. We don’t sell it, share it with third parties or use it for advertising.
privacy.p5: Game rooms are deleted automatically after 12 hours of inactivity. You can remove an uploaded photo on the Profile page at any time. To delete your account entirely, send a request on the GitHub project page below.

lobby.nobodyOnline: Nobody else in the lobby yet.
lobby.machineHostDesc: The machine deals the roles and runs the whole game. You're the room owner: you play and set the room up.
lobby.humanHostDesc: You open the host panel and narrate the game yourself, without playing.
lobby.noRooms: No rooms yet. Make one so others can join!

owner.setUp: Set the room up, then start
owner.waitingOwner: Waiting for the room owner to start…
owner.passwordOn: The room has a password. Type a new one to change it, or untick to open the room.

codes.title: Discount codes
codes.signIn: Sign in with Google on the Profile page to open this page.
codes.notAdmin: This account cannot manage codes. Add your email to ADMIN_EMAILS on the server, then sign in again.
codes.codeHint: 3–24 characters: letters, digits, - or _. Upper-cased automatically.
codes.valueHint: A percentage from 1 to 100, or an amount in VND.
codes.previewFree: Free: the item unlocks right away, no payment needed.
codes.expiresHint: Stops working after 23:59 that day. Empty: never expires.
codes.onePerAccount: Each account can use each code once. A use counts when the payment completes.
codes.confirmDelete: Delete code {code}? This cannot be undone.

share.copied: Invite link copied: paste it in your group so everyone can join
share.text: Come play Werewolf with me! Room {code}: open the link, type your name and you're in, no sign-in needed.
share.hint: Send the link to your group: they open it, type a name and they're in, no sign-in needed.

quests.title: Quests
quests.goldTitle: Your gold: earn it from quests, spend it in the Shop
quests.signIn: Sign in with Google to do quests and earn gold. Gold stays on your account and buys some effects in the Shop.
quests.checkinHint: Drop by every day for gold.
quests.bonusHint: Collect all 3 daily quests to open the gift.
quests.goldQuestsHint: Each one pays out once. Games you played before count too.

q.survive2: Survive to the end of {goal} games
q.power2: Play {goal} games with a power role
q.firstWolfWin: Win as a wolf for the first time
q.survive20: Survive to the end of {goal} games

collection.title: Role collection
collection.intro: Every win with a role brings that role's card closer to its next tier. The card you are dealt in a game shows the highest tier you have reached.
collection.signIn: Sign in with Google to save your profile and unlock card achievements. Every win raises that role's card to bronze, silver, gold and then rainbow.
collection.countRule: Every win counts, Standard and Casual.
collection.guestNote: Games you play while signed out don't count toward your collection.

freeRoles.lockedRole: Not open today, buy the role card to use it every day
freeRoles.lockedHint: Roles with 🔒 are not free today. A different group of special roles opens each day, and a room creator with the role card can use it any day.
freeRoles.hint: Each day a random group of special roles is free ({sizes} roles in turn). Once all {total} have had their day, they are shuffled and a new round begins. A role card opens that role every day in the rooms you create, and bundles are 20% off.
freeRoles.bundleHave: You have {have}/{total}, you only pay for the rest
